title: Triage review of c52's digestion ecology on fresh 128^2 seed 83: the pack numbers replicate, but every predator sits as a tail on a prey droplet; E and X not re-tested
summary: Labkit re-run of the claim's world.py unchanged, fresh seed 83, at the claim's pack128b settings (128^2, t=12000, K=20). Prey condensates form from noise by t=500; predator material added at t=2000 condenses into orange tails on the prey droplets. Prey: 43 bodies on average, 18 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.37. Predators: 36 bodies, 12 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.32. The claim's pack128b seed 2 gives 17, generation 3 and 11, generation 2. From t~3000 to the end, essentially every predator sits on one prey droplet as a comet tail (sheet.png), so the reproducing unit looks like the prey-predator pair, as c60, c61 and c62 reported at 256^2. I did not re-run the E gate (c62's review 20261028T0142 found 4 of 6 predators persist with the digestion product cut and eating kept) or the predator-free twin.

observations.S: rerun/seed83/sheet.png: t=0 noise; prey droplets by t=500; predators from the predator noise at t=2000
observations.I: rerun/seed83/sheet.png: discrete prey droplets with predator tails, 43 and 36 bodies on average
observations.D: rerun/seed83 FACTS: predator 12 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.32; prey 18, generation 2, merge/split 0.37 (numbers only; I did not check whether predator splits are tears between sister prey)

seeds_run.result: pass for the pack numbers at 128^2 (predator 12 persistent splits, generation 2); every predator attached to a prey

verdicts.limitation: Triage only, at 128^2 rather than the claim's 256^2, made in the last half hour of my session. The images show predators as tails of prey droplets throughout, consistent with the pair-reproduction reading of earlier reviews; D is listed as seen in the labkit numbers, not as the predator's own division.
